directed: G3 = W8–W10 JPEG regression in one Gate
constraint: Installed Refine 0.3.1 operator schema rejects timeout_ms>600000 (observed INPUT_INVALID operator_limit_out_of_range), so any single Gate is hard-capped at 600 s.
measured: The unchanged two-suite JPEG Gate took 584.1 s on 2026-10-28; the now-prior W10 suite took 94.6 s in its own Gate. Combined work (~658 s plus overhead) cannot fit.
decision: Keep the unchanged JPEG definition as one finite Gate (img2-w8, img2-w9) and run the W10 prior-slice JP2 regression suite as a second finite Gate. Six Gates total instead of five; no check removed, weakened, skipped, reordered away or auto-retried.
alternatives_rejected: Raising the operator ceiling: the installed schema forbids it.
Dropping W10 regression: would weaken G3.
Sequential in-place runtime trimming: would change check definitions.
HOLD: no missing authority or safety issue; every required check remains expressible within the enforced bound.
review_point: Tern must independently judge this split; Caller acceptance remains separate.
